exploration.title: Agent Execution Sandbox
openQuestions: master align Q10: Which comes first as the action-authorization proof: privileged read plus outbound sink, browser-to-terminal execution, citation-derived legal action, or model-generated code?
What exact authority grant and revocation model should govern tools, resources, credentials, delegation, and outbound sinks?
Which execution data must remain exact and immutable, and which secret-bearing data must be redacted, transient, or retention-limited?
Where are the ownership seams among governance policy, host isolation, credential brokering, execution records, and independent certification?
